name: @qu/space-core
description: Qu V5 PoC: Yjs-native Space/Node/Field core. Replaces QuStore/QuBit for the V5 redesign - a Node is a Y.Doc (meta + content), fields are typed per Kind-Schema ('atomic-encrypted' | 'text' | 'list'), every outgoing Yjs update is signed and sealed before it ever reaches storage or a transport (see envelope.js). No QuStore/QuBit compatibility layer - see docs/v5-concept.md.
